programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: The competition intensifies as teams head into their lake houses to transform their primary bedrooms and bathrooms; comfort and creativity take center stage as they showcase their vision and skill; while out on the lake, Scott and Bryan come up with a bold twist that pushes each duo even further out of their comfort zone; poor planning sends some teams scrambling towards risky shortcuts, and ambitious ideas spark clashes that threaten timelines.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: Scott and Bryan head out for their annual fishing showdown; teams dive into their kitchens and dining areas; unexpected storage challenges test their creativity and with the clock ticking, temperatures rise between teammates; unexpected obstacles force teams to make tough decisions, and mounting setbacks threaten to derail even the strongest plans; guest judge Debra Salmoni steps in to help determine who brought the heat in the kitchen.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: The teams are in for a big surprise as they're each tasked with building a whole other building, a bunkie! It's the ultimate test of both building and design skills, as the teams create unique purposes for the extra space that has to feel connected to their main property; Scott & Bryan catch some rays while teams struggle to complete their first build from the ground up; as the competition spreads out, the pressure mounts to finish in time.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: Scott & Bryan work on adding value to the property, while the teams take on two small but critical spaces, the front entry and main bathroom. These high-traffic areas demand clever functionality and must make a stellar first impression. It's a designer showdown as Chalon & Tatianna both swing for the fences, Marcy finds herself stretched beyond her comfort zone, and Taylor's indecision explodes into a full-blown wallpaper fiasco!

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: The teams move onto the guest bedrooms, needing to transform two full spaces that must feel unique yet cohesive with the rest of their Lake House; these rooms must suit any type of guest, and maybe even outshine the primary! But as a blast from the past shakes up the challenge, the teams must get creative to adapt and impress; riding the highs of recent wins and reeling from tough losses, teams take bigger risks, and dig deep as time, energy and patience run thin in the final weeks.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: To complete their lake houses, the teams take on the biggest task yet: the living room & and deck; these expansive spaces must flow together seamlessly, bringing the indoors out and the outdoors in to create a true lakefront oasis; with the finish line in sight, the pressure is higher than ever, and just when they think they've got it handled, Scott & Bryan introduce a surprise extra space that no one saw coming.
